note: Benthic foraminifer δ18O mixes deep-sea temperature and land ice: higher is colder or more ice. It is not converted to a temperature here.
thinning: smooth: means of 10,000-year bins of the LOESS smooth (10 bins of 2 kyr to 34 Ma, 5 bins of 5 kyr before); longTerm: means of 100,000-year bins of the long-term LOESS smooth
